ai.name: AI
ai.description: Cards from text, explanations, hints, answer checks and rewrites with Claude, OpenAI or a local model. Every request is shown before it is sent.

accepted_answers.name: Accepted answers
accepted_answers.description: Other answers the written check also accepts for a card ("bırakmak" next to "vazgeçmek"). Checked on this computer, no AI involved.

preview.heading: Before sending
preview.summary: {provider} · {model} · {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} will be sent.
preview.estimate: About {tokens} input tokens, at most {max} output tokens.
preview.local: This model runs on your computer.
preview.missing_key: This provider needs an API key. Add it under Providers.
preview.show: Show exactly what will be sent

budget.exceeded: This goes over your monthly budget of {limit}.
budget.warning: You are close to your monthly budget of {limit}.

generate.source_hint: Paste a text to make cards from
generate.truncated: The answer was cut off; there may be fewer notes than asked.
generate.added: Added {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}, skipped {skipped}.
generate.add: Add {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}
generate.no_deck: There is no deck for the cards yet: make one first in Create › Add.
generate.no_provider: To make cards, connect an AI provider first (once; there are free options).

providers.heading: Providers
providers.no_keychain: No system keychain: API keys cannot be stored here.
providers.key_set: An API key is stored in the system keychain.
providers.key_saved: Key saved to the system keychain.
providers.session_keychain: Keys are kept only for this session on this system (they may disappear after you log out). You may need to enter them again.
providers.move_key: New address: {url}. An API key is stored for the old one. Send it to the new address too?
providers.intro: Every request is shown to you before it is sent. Keys stay in the system keychain.
providers.what_for: AI can make cards from a text, fill empty fields while you write, and explain or give hints while you study. It is entirely optional: it stays off and nothing is sent until you set up a provider.
providers.none_hint: Press “Add provider”: Claude, OpenRouter, Gemini or Ollama running on your computer…
providers.key_not_needed: No key needed (enter one if your server asks for it).
providers.advanced_note: If the address changes, you are asked before a stored key is sent to the new one.
providers.name: Name
providers.default_intro: Used for every feature you did not give its own provider below.

routes.heading: Model per feature
routes.intro: Use a strong model for making cards and a fast one for checks, for example.

prices.heading: Prices
prices.intro: USD per million tokens, used for estimates. Providers change prices: keep them current.

usage.line: {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} · {input} in / {output} out tokens · {cost}
usage.estimate_note: Costs are estimates from the price table.

source.url_note: Only the page's text is read; no scripts run. Nothing goes to the AI until you preview and send.
source.pages_read: Pages {from}–{to} of {count}. Edit the text below as you like.
source.page_read: Text of “{title}”. Edit it below as you like.
source.truncated: The text was long and has been cut. Pick fewer pages or a shorter part.

ai.subtitle: Make cards from text, and choose the providers and models the app may use.

setup.title: Add provider
setup.gallery_intro: Which one do you want to use? To start for free: Gemini, Groq or OpenRouter. To send nothing over the internet: Ollama or LM Studio.
setup.key_intro: Create an API key in your {name} account and paste it here.
setup.key_hint: Stored only in the system keychain; the app never shows it again.
setup.local_intro: {name} must be open on your computer with its server running. No key needed.
setup.custom_intro: Enter the address of the OpenAI-compatible service (without /chat/completions). Servers on your computer or home network need no key.
setup.model_intro: Pick a model from the list or type its name. The list comes from the provider.
setup.test_intro: A very short request (a few tokens) is sent to {model}; you see the result here.
setup.model_placeholder: Search or type a model name
setup.models_failed: Could not fetch the list: {reason}. You can type a model name.
setup.more_models: {count, plural, one {# more model: narrow the search} other {# more models: narrow the search}}

anthropic.description: Anthropic's Claude models. Very good at making cards; paid.

openrouter.description: One key for hundreds of models; some are free.

gemini.description: Google's Gemini models; has a free quota.

groq.description: Open models with very fast answers; has a free quota.

ollama.description: Models run on your own computer; nothing leaves it.

lmstudio.description: An app that downloads models and runs them on your computer.

custom.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
custom.description: Any OpenAI-compatible address: your own server or another service.

outcome.no_key: No key: save the API key first.
outcome.wrong_key: The key was rejected. Make sure you copied all of it, or create a new one.
outcome.no_credit: No credit or quota left on the account. Add balance on the provider's site, or pick a free model.
outcome.model_not_found: This model was not found or this key may not use it. Pick another model from the list.
outcome.wrong_address: The expected service is not at this address. Check the address (Advanced).
outcome.rate_limited: Too many requests right now. Try again in a moment.
outcome.service_down: The provider is having problems. Try again in a moment.
outcome.cannot_reach: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and the address.
outcome.cannot_reach_local: Could not reach the {name} server. Is the app open with its server running?
outcome.tls: Could not make a secure connection (certificate). A proxy or antivirus may be interfering.

test.list_only: The model list came back. Once you pick a model, the test sends it a short request too.

ai.settings_subtitle: Connect an AI provider and see what it has used. Making cards lives in Create › AI; AI also helps while you write and study cards.
ai.generate_subtitle: Paste a text or take it from a file; the AI suggests cards and you add the ones you like.

auto.title: Help that runs by itself
auto.description: Where AI works without you asking. All start off.

meaning.title: Meaning in this sentence
meaning.lead: The AI tells you which meaning the word has in this card's sentence. Your card changes only when you apply it.
meaning.also_correct: Also correct (your written answers will accept them): {list}
meaning.replace_field: Also put it in the card's meaning
meaning.failed: No suggestion came back. Try again.

reason.no_sentence: This card has no sentence to read the word in.
reason.no_word: This card has no word to explain.
reason.no_meaning_field: This card type has no meaning field.

validation.ai_provider: Check the provider's name, address or model.
validation.ai_key: The API key looks wrong (empty, too long or with spaces).
validation.ai_task: This request cannot be sent as it is.
validation.ai_price: Prices must be numbers from 0, with a model name.
validation.ai_source: This source cannot be used (check the address, file or pages).
validation.accepted_answer: This accepted answer cannot be saved (check the field, its length or how many there are).

conflict.ai_no_provider: No AI provider yet. Add one under AI → Providers.
conflict.ai_no_model: Choose a model for this provider.
conflict.ai_preview_stale: Something changed since the preview. Preview again.
conflict.ai_budget_exceeded: This month's AI budget is spent, so nothing is sent automatically.
conflict.ai_auto_off: Asking without a preview is off. Turn on "Suggest meanings for captured words" in the AI settings.

provider.ai_unauthorized: The provider rejected the API key (or none is set).
provider.ai_rate_limited: Rate limit reached. Try again later.
provider.ai_invalid_output: The answer was not in the expected format.
provider.ai_keychain: The system keychain is not available.
provider.ai_source: The web page could not be fetched. Try again later.

monthly_budget_usd.label: Monthly AI budget (USD)
monthly_budget_usd.description: Warns when this month's estimated cost nears it. 0 = no budget.

request_timeout_secs.label: AI request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for an answer.

allow_private_hosts.label: Allow fetching local-network pages
allow_private_hosts.description: Off by default: pages on this computer or your local network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, …) are blocked when making cards from a web address.

max_retries.label: AI retries
max_retries.description: How often a rate-limited or unavailable request is retried.

prompt.description: The instructions sent for this feature; parts in double braces are filled in. The request is always shown before sending.

auto_suggest.label: Suggest meanings for captured words
auto_suggest.description: When on, a captured word's sentence goes to your AI provider without a preview and the answer is kept only as a suggestion (your card changes when you apply it; stops at the monthly budget).

routes.set: Set AI model for a feature

sources.extract: Read a card source (PDF, web page)
